note: Statutory Jersey filing deadlines the runner checks Karbon's own templates and work items against. Sources are listed per entry. Carl confirms the per-client period before any of this is treated as authoritative: a client may hold Revenue Jersey approval for a non-standard GST period, and that is a fact about the client, not about the rule.

deadline_types.label: GST return and payment
deadline_types.rule: The return is due no later than the last day of the month following the end of the return period. Periods are normally three months. A quarter ending 31 March is therefore due 30 April.

deadline_shape.description: Every GST deadline date should fall on the final day of a calendar month.

deadline_types.late_consequence: £100 surcharge for a late return, and a further £100 per month up to nine months if it remains undelivered.
caveats: Monthly and annual return periods exist by approval from the Comptroller. If a client is on one of those, the quarterly expectation below will report a mismatch that is correct for the rule and wrong for that client.
The payment deadline runs with the return deadline; a template that tracks only the filing is tracking half the obligation.

deadline_types.label: Combined Employer Return (ITIS, social security contributions and manpower)
deadline_types.authority: Revenue Jersey and Customer and Local Services
deadline_types.rule: The combined employer return, and payment of ITIS deductions and Class 1 contributions, are due by the 15th day of the month following the month the contributions relate to.

deadline_shape.description: Every CER deadline date should fall on the 15th of a month.

deadline_types.late_consequence: Late payment of contributions attracts penalties and interest; persistent lateness is enforced by Customer and Local Services.
caveats: One return now covers tax, social security and manpower together. A firm still running separate ITIS and social security work items is tracking a return that no longer exists in that form.
The 15th is a calendar day, not a working day. The runner counts calendar days for exactly this reason.

deadline_types.label: Personal income tax return
deadline_types.rule: For a year of assessment, a paper return is due by midnight on 31 May of the following year and an online return by midnight on 31 July of the following year.

deadline_shape.description: Every personal tax deadline date should fall on 31 May or 31 July.

deadline_types.late_consequence: A late filing penalty applies, with further penalties if the return remains outstanding.
caveats: 31 May and 31 July are different deadlines for the same obligation, not a deadline and a grace period. Which one applies depends on how that client files.
A template carrying only 31 July will look compliant for online filers and will quietly miss every paper filer by two months.
